Code corroborated symbolic identities, full eigenvalues, pair resistances, and full-edge numerical optimizers; infinite correctness rests on the proof.

value.rationale: A natural three-community shortcut network admits a complete independently-variable conductance optimization theorem, a sharp price ratio for removing an entire edge class while maintaining connectivity, and an analytic 1/m scaling window with a finite-size exception. These go beyond a numerical entry or a routine restatement of convexity and give a structural network-design benchmark. Scope is honestly restricted to equal communities and linear conductance prices.
